selected_version.basis: v2/MANIFEST.md and HANDOFF.md explicitly declare V2 delivered analysis; original snapshot retained. Not selected by results or mtime.

verification.block4: Store C23 and SF C21, excluded structurally from primary complete-block analysis; Store pair only sensitivity n7
verification.statistical_pure_function_checks: Only AST-extracted mean/sd/med/bootstrap_ci/signflip_p/holm evaluated in receiver process; no GLM module/main/output entry executed. Eight primary contrasts and four n6/n7 sensitivity estimates match delivered numerical output.

methods.signflip: All 2^n assignments; two-sided abs(mean paired differences), >= observed -1e-12; 64 assignments for n6.
methods.holm: Four contrasts separately per cost window, sorted p stepdown running max, capped1; business fourth p_raw=p_Holm=.5625, other three .03125/.125; including preparation four .03125/.125.
methods.bootstrap: 10000; random.Random(20261024) restarted per estimate, paired-block differences sampled with replacement, percentile indices floor(p*(B-1))=249/9749.
methods.meanratio: mean(A)/mean(B) on paired set, not mean per-block ratios
methods.cohens_dz: mean paired difference / sample SD of differences
methods.including_preparation: preparation_s + command_to_correct_business_response_s, excludes measured preparation-to-command gap
methods.CI: Marginal intervals, not Holm simultaneous intervals; no primary family p<.05. Sign-invariance/independence and block exchangeability are assumptions not proven by six observational blocks.

definitions.A: startup_command_ns immediately before register HTTP -> received_ns immediately after first arithmetic HTTP returns including JSON parse/context close, gold assertion later; stored as correct_business_response_ns
definitions.B: business_trigger_ns -> same first arithmetic HTTP completion
definitions.fixed32: Third correctness request, not the measured startup endpoint.
definitions.phase_spans: min(rank begin) to max(rank end), all eight ranks; spans may overlap and cannot be summed or called pure IO/CUDA.
definitions.stacked: event-intervals.csv five mutually exclusive segments include preparation-to-register gap; inferential including_preparation omits that tiny gap. Backend first token is not client streaming TTFT.

graph_inputs.rule: Preserve populations n6/n6/n7/n7 for descriptive26 or explicitly choose six complete blocks for primary; do not mix these silently. No Kimi data fabricated.
